script_text: Stop! Aries, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mars, your fiery ruling planet, is forming a tense square to Venus in your 7th House of Partnerships, creating friction and misunderstandings in your closest relationships. Simultaneously, Jupiter trines your 10th House of Career, opening doors for professional growth and recognition. If you're single, this passionate energy attracts intense but potentially chaotic connections; focus on your own fire before diving in. If you're taken, watch for unresolved arguments that could escalate over trivial matters today, especially with a Mars-Venus clash. In your career, your 10th House is brilliantly lit by Jupiter, so seize leadership opportunities and speak up in meetings. Financially, avoid impulsive spending in your 2nd House of Income; a sudden, profound insight about your true path may come from an unexpected mentor as a blessing. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
